data.name: Nesreen
data.gender_notes: Nesreen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nisr', meaning 'bird'. Nesreen refers to a beautiful, graceful woman, like a blooming flower. The name Nesreen carries the meaning “Graceful bloom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nesreen usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful bloom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nesreen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful bloom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nesreen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نسريّن
in_arabic.meaning: زهرة الورد الأبيض، جميلة، ناصعة البياض، ذات جمال فائق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نسريّن هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويعني زهرة الورد الأبيض، أو الورد الناصع البياض، وهو ما يوحي بجمال فائق، وينسب إلى الورد الذي يرمز إلى الجمال والرقة في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية، وقد ورد في بعض الآداب العربية القديمة كرمز للجمال الخُلقي والخَلقي.

in_urdu.name: نسریں
in_urdu.meaning: سفید گلاب کا پھول، خوبصورت، سفید رنگ کی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نسریں ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سفید گلاب یا خوبصورت، اور یہ گلاب کی پھول کی علامت ہے جو خوبصورتی اور رقت کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں گلاب کو خوبصورتی اور رقت کا نمائندہ माना جاتا ہے، اور اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیانแพร่ کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: नेस्रीन
in_hindi.meaning: सफेद गुलाब का फूल, सुंदर, श्वेत वर्ण की
in_hindi.long_meaning: नेस्रीन एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है सफेद गुलाब का फूल या सुंदर, यह नाम गुलाब के फूल से लिया गया है जो सुंदरता और कोमलता का प्रतीक है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग किया जाता है और यह नाम सुंदरता और सादगी का प्रतीक माना जाता है.

in_pashto.name: نسري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نسري د عربي اصل يو مؤنث نوم دی، چې معنی يې سپینه ګل يا ښکلۍ ده، دا نوم د ګل د پټۍ نښه ده چې ښکلا او رقت څرګندوي، په افغان او پښتني دود کې دا نوم د ښکلا او سادگي د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Nesreen
in_english.meaning: White rose, beautiful, pure, lovely, and charming
in_english.long_meaning: Nesreen is a female given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'white rose' or 'beautiful', derived from the Arabic word for rose which symbolizes beauty and delicacy, the name carries a rich history in Islamic tradition and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify purity, beauty, and elegance, the rose being a significant motif in Arabic literature and poetry.

In day-to-day usage, it signifies a woman of refined sensibilities, one who is admired for her charm, intellect, and graceful demeanor.

historical_references.reference: Nesreen bint Milhana, a female poet from Basra, lived during the early Abbasid period (750-825 CE). She was a contemporary of the famous poet Al-Jahiz and is known for her poetry in both Arabic and Syriac languages.
historical_references.context: Female poet from Basra, contemporary of Al-Jahiz, wrote poetry in Arabic and Syriac.

historical_references.reference: Nesreen, also known as Umm Kulthum, was a celebrated singer and actress during the Fatimid period (969-1171 CE). She was famous for her renditions of Sufi poetry, particularly the works of Al-Busiri and Ibn Arabi, and is considered one of the most influential figures in Middle Eastern music history.
historical_references.context: Celebrated singer and actress, famous for her renditions of Sufi poetry.
